name: aviation-weather-mcp-server
description: Fetch METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, domestic/international SIGMETs and CWAs from NWS AWC via MCP. AIRMETs not served. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

interface.shortDescription: METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, domestic/international SIGMETs and CWAs. AIRMETs not served.
interface.longDescription: Fetch METARs, TAFs, PIREPs, domestic/international SIGMETs and Center Weather Advisories from the NWS Aviation Weather Center, plus station discovery. AIRMETs are not served. Advisory coverage names failed sources and preserves sparse bulletin fields and multipart geometry. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.
